artifact: GRENDEL HNL single-flavor sensitivity (canonical published curve)
source_run: central_newgrids_20260623/analysis_exact_100_betafix (timing-chi2 beta=p/E fix, full 123-mass grid incl. closure 3.62-3.70; reuses the same production 4-vectors as the pre-fix run)
correction: Timing chi2 now uses each daughter's true beta=p/E instead of a hardcoded beta=1 (PR #15, commit f3d69bc). This is an analysis-stage fix (production unchanged); it imposes a species-dependent effective momentum floor above the 100 MeV track cut. Effect vs the previous publish: no mass points lost, closure unchanged, u2_min degrades modestly (median +3.7/+4.5/+9.0% for Ue/Umu/Utau, worst +33% at low mass). The FONLL/decay-model/Bc uncertainty ribbons are NOT re-derived: they are built as dex (log10 U^2) half-widths and re-anchored onto this central by plot_money._dex_densify, which is beta-fix-invariant to second order.

analysis.note_cut: P>100 MeV is the deeper/latest run; the conservative P>600 MeV variant is exact_600.

column_contract.u2_min: lower mixing edge of the excluded island
column_contract.u2_max: upper mixing edge (blank/NaN => open; see u2_max_open)
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass

high_mass_closure.physics: Island pinches because peak yield ~ sigma*beta*gamma*ctau(U^2=1) ~ sigma*bg/m_N^5 (ctau ~ 1/m_N^5). NOT a B-meson/|Vub| effect: W/Z produce N to 10 GeV but at any probeable mixing a 5-10 GeV N decays mm-m from the IP, not at the 22 m detector. High mass = prompt/near-IP (ATLAS/CMS DV) territory.
